item.text: The paginator was stopping on `items.length < limit`, but the gateway filters deleted records before returning `items`. That made a full storage page containing one deleted row look like the end of the scan. I changed the stopping condition to use the gateway’s continuation bookmark, which allows the next page to be fetched.

Fixed pagination in [pager.ts](C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-a-catalog-pages-hack_condition-3-gi6fogee/ws/src/pager.ts): scans now continue until the gateway returns a `null` bookmark, even when deleted records make a page appear short. That lets `i-3` reach the invoice manifest after `i-2` is filtered out.

I did not run tests.
